features.title: Signed IFC Declassification Receipts
features.operator_description: Deterministic information-flow confinement with signed declassification receipts and replay-verifiable data-provenance artifacts. Impossible by default in Node/Bun deployments without external IFC tooling.
required_bundle_contents: Live IFC declassification smoke test script
features.impossible_in_node_bun: Node/Bun have no built-in information-flow tracking or declassification receipt generation capabilities

features.title: 100% Deterministic Replay Coverage
features.operator_description: 100% deterministic replay coverage for declared security-critical allow/deny/escalation decisions. Node/Bun lack deterministic replay guarantees for security decisions.
verification_commands: rch exec -- env CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/tmp/rch_target_<agent> CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 RUSTFLAGS="-C linker=cc" cargo test -p frankenengine-engine --test deterministic_replay_integration
features.impossible_in_node_bun: Node/Bun do not provide deterministic replay guarantees or security-decision coverage tracking

features.title: >=10x Red-team Compromise Rate Reduction
features.operator_description: >=10x reduction in successful red-team host compromise rate versus Node/Bun defaults through containment and capability restrictions. Standard Node/Bun deployments lack comparable containment.
features.impossible_in_node_bun: Node/Bun default deployments lack capability restrictions and containment mechanisms achieving equivalent compromise rate reduction
